collection.attribution: Nathan Hagen, LensLibrary; original design cited below when the source states it

original_publication.note: the upstream collection bundles this patent publication with the design

title: Petzval portrait lens

spectrum.sampling_wavelengths_basis: SOURCE_STATED air wavelengths at 20 C and 101325 Pa, converted once to vacuum with the engine's own air model (6432.8 / 2949810 / 25540, material_physics.air_index_exact)

sampling_span_nm.note: one stated sampling wavelength; the interval is a 1 nm numerical band around it

continuous_coverage_nm.note: a set of enabled wavelengths is sampling evidence; nothing in the source establishes continuous coverage between them, so no range is claimed

back_focal_length_mm.definition: from the last surface vertex to the paraxial image point

total_track_mm.definition: first surface vertex to the image plane along the axis

engine_check.method: thick-lens paraxial ABCD through the committed Project's COMPOUND unit

comparison.why_this_scale: a back focal length can pass through zero, so it cannot set its own tolerance; the system focal length sets the scale of a first-order comparison, and the larger of the two covers a long back focus behind a short focal length

f_number.definition: image-space f-number, the system aperture the design file states

property_list_comparison.note: the collection's hand-maintained property list, kept for comparison only

field.definition: field angle; the full field is twice the largest stated half field
field.basis: SOURCE_STATED (the design file's FTYP field type and YFLN field points)

property_list_comparison.note: the collection's hand-maintained property list; its field convention is not consistent across rows (full field, half field, or an object height on an angle-typed design), so it is not used as a field value

model_glasses.name: LL-MODEL-1.51100-60.60
model_glasses.basis: constant index 1.5132162875150814 at the single stated wavelength 550.150191 nm

model_glasses.name: LL-MODEL-1.62000-36.30

materials.policy: Every glass is defined from the source's own per-surface index table in the upstream prescription dump: a 3-term Sellmeier with fixed poles solved to those samples, or a constant index when the source states one wavelength. Published catalog glasses are compared, never substituted.

approximations.detail: the source gives no stop-plate outer radius; the plate reaches the largest clear semi-diameter beside the stop
the source gives clear semi-diameters only, so each surface is edged at its own clear semi-diameter
nominal prescription surfaces; no figure, centring or surface-roughness error is modelled

notes: project check accepted the committed Project with os-optics 0.14.0
project solids reported no error-severity finding
the engine's paraxial EFL and BFL meet the stated tolerance rule
no field verification: this batch built no per-field configurations, so no field-dependent quantity is asserted (follow-up: issue #7)

record_hash_method: SHA-256 over this record's JSON with the record_hash and record_hash_method members removed: json.dumps(..., sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False) encoded as UTF-8, no trailing newline. Recompute it from the committed record.json after parsing the JSON, not from the file's bytes.
